cost_split.why: the spread of simulated durations (1.04 s) is too small next to the scatter in host time (median residual 19 s) to determine a rate. Tests with very different simulated durations would determine it; these do not.

note: Host seconds per simulated second. The host clock varies with load and no verdict depends on it; this ratio is a fact about the machine, not about the firmware. It is a property of THIS SUITE as well as of the emulator: a suite of short tests is dominated by per-test startup, which cost_split separates.
